# Actions

*Last updated: 2026-01-21*

---

## Status Legend
- 🟡 **Open:** Not yet started or in progress
- 🟢 **Complete:** Finished and verified
- 🔴 **Blocked:** Waiting for blocker to resolve
- ⚪ **Cancelled:** Will not be completed (with reason)

---

## How to Read This File

- Each action has exactly one owner
- Owner is responsible for status updates
- Actions are never auto-closed (require explicit confirmation)
- Completed actions are preserved in history, never deleted

---

## Template (Do Not Edit)

```markdown
### A[N]: [Clear action title]

**Owner:** [Name]
**Status:** 🟡 Open | 🟢 Complete | 🔴 Blocked | ⚪ Cancelled
**Created:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Due:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Last Updated:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Source:** [Meeting date or Decision #]

**Description:**
[One sentence describing what needs to happen]

**Blocker (if blocked):**
[What is blocking this action?]

**Progress:**
- [YYYY-MM-DD] [Status update]
```
